protocol.timing: Synchronized wall clock, full forward plus temporal readout and state reset. Excludes IO, preprocessing and H2D.
protocol.order: Seed-0 shuffled model order per image; all models interleaved.
protocol.equations: v += (x-v)/tau, threshold >= 1, hard reset 0, initial v=0 per image.
protocol.runtime_storage: Stored parameter/buffer elements in the inference graph; distinct from trained parameter count.
